decisions.reason: Using the supplied logo does not change the required homepage sections or their information goal.
The logo decision does not change the requirement that the site be mobile-friendly.
The approved logo is a branding asset and does not alter the competitor-inspired layout, structure, navigation, or visual-composition rules.
The logo decision does not change package catalogs or pricing consistency across locations.

The reusable location strategy already requires consistent Shatter House branding; approving a specific logo does not change the expansion or template behavior and is owned by the brand-identity requirement.
The source does not cancel or alter reuse of legacy content, images, or booking information, nor does it identify the old logo as a reused item requiring removal.
Using the new logo does not change legacy-site availability or master-site linkage during the transition.
The logo approval does not modify the existing SEO-preservation goal or migration-handling rules.
A shared branding asset does not change the required isolation of location analytics, revenue tracking, or reporting.
The logo decision has no effect on separation of Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley customer databases.
The logo decision does not affect location-specific gift-card operations.
The logo decision does not affect operational separation of location memberships.
